unresolved_gaps: No ResonantOS runtime profile binds the public subagent-strategy lifecycle to host capability discovery, validation, confirmation, dispatch, orchestration, persistence, notifications, or recovery.
No public-neutral adapter converts a natural-language multi-agent request into a preview-only strategy proposal without leaking DomainSpec private schema, agent-pool, ledger, or artifact paths.
No current ResonantOS owner can execute a general capability-bound multi-agent route while preserving ComputeJob, DelegationPacket, TaskWorkspace, GoalWorkspace, artifact, and approval authority.
No current UI supports strategy preview, selective context, per-child status, targeted clarification, partial failure, explicit consume, cancellation acknowledgement, or resume.
The public Arcanum package remains seed/flagged because medium and complex consuming-profile and registrar proof is incomplete.
No accepted degraded-mode contract distinguishes capability absent, host operation absent, user declines, one-helper fallback, serial fallback, proposal export, and hard block.
No browser test executes the accepted subagent-strategy plus Whisper two-child witness.
The ResonantOS consumer has no product-local Inventory machine index.
design_consequences: The dispatch uses four lanes: portable lifecycle and authority boundary, current consumer integration, conversational human control, and external protocol plus degraded-mode precedent.

The first implementation candidate must be an adapter over existing RouteDecision and Run projections plus current ComputeJob, DelegationPacket, TaskWorkspace, GoalWorkspace, and artifact owners; a second scheduler, registry, or session store is a reject condition.

The first user-visible slice must turn free language into a no-side-effect multi-agent proposal card, require one explicit approval, launch two isolated children through real owners, preserve parent conversation, and expose independently consumable results or blockers.

The integration must support honest capability gaps: preview-only export, single bounded helper, serial execution, route-to-install or hardening owner, or block are possible outcomes, but none may be silently substituted.

DomainSpec schema, agent identities, telemetry ledger, and private artifact paths remain a server-side or adapter-owned implementation detail; the consumer contract must use public-neutral capabilities, roles, scopes, gates, and result handles.
non_authority_notice: Inventory matches are discovery read models. Current repository bytes, primary external sources, and agent-produced cited evidence must support research claims; this packet does not authorize dispatch, ResonantOS code changes, Arcanum promotion, capability installation, or release.
